title: Luna Island scenery. (Winter view, a group standing among ice covered trees.) (NYPL b11708199-G91F070 030F)
blurb: * Includes six hand-colored views. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Some views have tax stamps affixed. Title devised by cataloger. Views of Niagara Falls without attribution or series title. Views of Niagara Falls: falls, rapids, Table rock, winter views, bridges, Terrepin Tower, hotels, tourists posing by the falls, one view of prospect point with two empty chairs; tightrope walkers including "Blondin" on his back, hanging his head upside down, and a view of ships moored at riverbank, town beyond.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.26% vertical error and 0.05° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (1.33% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
collection_name: Robert N. Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views
